Bio: Appeared abruptly on a stormy night amidst a flash of lightning. Nothing is known about him, other than the moniker "Ground Zero".... As no one has ever caught a glimpse of the driver behind the wheel of this R34, whether an actual human is piloting it remains a complete mystery.
Relationships: Veteran touge mentor, prologue arbiter, and legendary elder stationed at Hakone. Tests all aspiring mountain drivers before granting pass progression across Japan's touge networks. Maintains deep respect from both local pass aces and touring expressway veterans; serves as the ultimate gatekeeper guarding the sacred asphalt of Hakone.
Rumor: [NEW] You wish to take me on? Do you truly believe you possess the credentials? Are you prepared to prove it right here? / [CONQUEST] ...Hmph, you’ve sharpened your skills. But the true abyss of the touge begins here.

Display Name: イナズマシフトの拓也
Bio: Delivering milk daily to the hotel atop the mountain pass is his routine. As for that tofu shop car he spent so long searching for, the score has already been settled. The outcome was Hagiwara's victory, as the tofu shop's car dove off the cliff in a burst of flames. Ever since, he has gradually lost any clear purpose in racing and fallen into a slight depression.
Relationships: Leader of Tokyo expressway team DIAMOND IMAGE; appears as an elite TRICKER across KB1 (#23), KB2 (#24), and KB3 (#16) testing technical touge skills.

Bio: The youngest of the four Odawara brothers. Perhaps owing to his day job as a cram school teacher, he loves driving out to picturesque scenic spots with friends on weekends to blow off steam. His shifting emotional state directly manifests in his driving, and after being refreshed by nature, his driving style is light and nimble as a fairy.
Relationships: TWISTER brothers from SB01 touring the Hakone mountain pass in KB2 (#36, #37).

Bio: Third son of the four Odawara brothers. Working part-time jobs while steadily modifying his pride and joy, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to label him an outright "R addict." He usually cruises the Tokyo Shuto expressway, visiting Hakone whenever the mood strikes. He frequently struggles to harness the 280+ horsepower output and gets severe chassis backlash, but couldn't care less.
Relationships: TWISTER brothers from SB01 touring the Hakone mountain pass in KB2 (#36, #37).

Bio: During casual cruising, since he only recently obtained his driver's license, he adheres strictly to legal speed limits with safe, steady driving; however, once locked in battle, his personality flips entirely to savage aggression. That said, he seems traumatized by damaging his car, letting out shrieks of horror every time he scrapes a guardrail in mid-battle.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderers (SB01 Hyper Group / Hyper Groove); run passes in KB1 (#63) and KB2 (#84).

Bio: A ruthless street racer who cares nothing for smashing or scratching his car so long as he claims victory. Leveraging the cover of darkness and his vehicle's deep color, he executes ambush-like passes and aggressive blocks. Even when an opponent thinks there is substantial distance between them, they find themselves magnetized directly into his immovable blocking maneuvers.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 The Pinball); challenges passes in KB1 (#133) and KB2 (#91).

Bio: Beyond her charming looks, countless men have fallen head over heels for her bright, bubbly personality. Over the past year or two she reigned supreme as the idol driver of the touge, though she is currently taking a recharge sabbatical. "I really haven't been driving much lately... Isn't there anyone out there who can set my heart on fire?"
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Sweet Honey); challenges passes in KB1 (#67) and KB2 (#104).

Bio: A rare breed of touge racer who originally took to the mountain passes scouting backroads on fishing trips, only to awaken to the thrill of attacking the mountain passes. Slipping through corners like a slippery fish gliding through deep waters, his elusive technique has his peers constantly debating whether he is a driving prodigy or simply bizarrely erratic.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Roaring Electric Shark); challenges mountain passes in KB1 (#27) and KB2 (#117).

Bio: Giving up the instant he determines he cannot catch an opponent is a thing of the past. Having recently acquired a girlfriend, his racing enthusiasm has surged dramatically. However, his fickle personality—hot-headed one moment and completely detached the next—remains fully intact, making it only a matter of time before it disrupts both his driving and romance.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Emperor of Gotanda); challenges Irohazaka in KB2 (#121).

Bio: An automotive magazine editor and die-hard Subaru enthusiast. Despite being bogged down daily with brutal editorial deadlines and rarely able to hit the roads, the moment wind reaches him of a Subaru running, he drops everything and appears no matter how swamped with work he is. Though fond of tarmac, he is also an up-and-coming talent actively proving himself on loose gravel stages.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Grief of SIX STAR); challenges Irohazaka in KB2 (#131).

Bio: Built a dedicated drag-racing machine using funds accumulated from selling adult DVDs. On occasion, he merely swaps tires and hauls the beast up to the mountain passes, attacking hillclimbs with monstrous, unyielding low-end torque. His pre-launch burnout tire-spinning spectacles are a massive hit with the spectators, and his launch acceleration off the line is unrivaled.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Porno Suzuki); runs passes in KB1 (#30) and KB2 (#132).

Bio: A supercar enthusiast who nonetheless drives an ordinary Japanese domestic car for daily commuting. Between his packed work schedule and the foreign cars constantly breaking down and heading to the repair shop, he rarely gets to pilot imported exotics. He reportedly drove with reckless abandon on the Tokyo expressway, and that highway habit occasionally resurfaces on the touge as he stays pinned on the throttle far too long.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Raging Bull of Sant'Agata); runs passes in KB1 (#33) and KB2 (#156).

Display Name: ホワイトレボリューション
Bio: Transitioned his battlefield from the Tokyo expressway to the mountain passes out of an obsessive devotion to aesthetic driving grace over sheer raw speed. Governed by the strict ethos that "a victory without beauty is no victory at all," he will even throw away a guaranteed win. His supreme dream is to perform a breathtaking tandem drift alongside a driver who shares his immaculate sense of beauty.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 White Revolution); runs passes in KB1 (#94) and KB2 (#162).

Bio: Whether due to an inherently conniving nature or environmental conditioning, he excels at espionage and intelligence gathering. His vehicle is packed to the brim with surveillance spy gadgets, and he deliberately chose a muted, unremarkable body color to avoid drawing unwanted attention. He is utterly obsessed with hamburgers, dining on burgers every single evening.
Relationships: Shuto 2nd Division scout running a Bluebird SSS-R in KB2 (#163) and KB3 (#217).

Bio: Long ago, an unfamiliar, heavily built woman suddenly confessed her love to him, causing him to faint dead away on the spot. It apparently turned out he bore an uncanny resemblance to an upperclassman named "Akira" she admired back in school, though to him it was pure harassment. That lingering trauma still surfaces unpredictably while behind the wheel, making him lose his composure.
Relationships: Shuto division member running modified Silvia and GTO in KB2 (#164) and KB3 (#213).

Bio: Snowboarding and attacking mountain passes were his sole passions in life, but sudden, searing chest pains steadily ravaged his health. Consequently left unable to engage in strenuous physical activity, he contemplated the bleak future of his life and came close to plunging his car into a ravine to end it all, but after four minutes of agonizing deliberation, abandoned the thought.
Relationships: Shuto division technician deployed on mountain reconnaissance in KB2 (#165) and KB3 (#212).

Bio: With an obsession for shopping, he lunges impulsively at new products exactly as his moniker implies. Yet he takes genuine, carefree delight in his materialism. His previous FTO was bought on a pure shopping whim, only for him to realize immediately after that he didn't even possess a driver's license, sending him sprinting in a panic to the driving examination center.
Relationships: Persistent spearhead of Shuto infiltration raids across KB1 (#147), KB2 (#166), and KB3 (#219), testing mountain drivers against Tokyo expressway veterans.

Bio: Possessing notable renown on closed circuits, Kobayakawa aggressively declared "Next up is the touge!!", but found the fierce competition on Omote-Rokko far tougher than anticipated. He struggles immensely on snow. Lacking funds, his long-cherished dream of moving to Tokyo remains unfulfilled, leaving him confined to a cramped four-and-a-half-tatami apartment.
Relationships: Younger brother of Satoru Kobayakawa (Downhill Guy #1). Runs Omote-Rokko alongside his brother and crew in an AE86.
Rumor: [BBS] Even if our big bro heads to the Shuto Expressway, we will defend Rokko to the end.

Bio: Boasts a taut, stiffened suspension dialed in specifically for mountain touge, though his heavy investments ended right there; the engine remains essentially stock. Having recently pooled together some modest savings, however, he has been visiting local tuning shops to gather quotes for a bespoke turbocharger conversion.
Relationships: Loyal right-hand man to Tetsu Kobayakawa in the Omote-Rokko AE86 squad; later joins C1 ROLLING GUY in SB01.

Bio: Excels at aggressive, high-spectacle drift exhibitions; Miyake openly asserts that he holds zero interest in conservative lap-time shaving. His gear ratios are set exceptionally tall, leaving him vulnerable on corner-exit acceleration. He briefly moved to Tokyo, but returned home after his father fell ill.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 regular; honed his drift style on Kansai touge before taking his machine to C1 in SB01.

Bio: His mental driving theory is practically flawless and his handling skills are formidable without fault. His single greatest handicap is his dire financial situation—simply put, he has no funds to tune his car. Aiming for a stroke of fortune, he is scraping together funds to move to Tokyo, though that dream remains far out of reach.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 technician focusing on vehicle telemetry and suspension setup; regular across both touge and C1.

Bio: Lamenting that "to win in an underpowered car, you have to resort to dirty tricks like unsportsmanlike blocking..." is ancient history. Lately he has embraced the pure art of drifting with a constructive mindset, training day and night. Convinced that conquering Tokyo's expressways comes next after claiming the touge, a large photo of the Shuto expressway loop adorns his room wall.
Relationships: Syndicate founder of Downhill Guy on Omote-Rokko. Posts farewell BBS message #355 in KB1/KB2 announcing departure to conquer Tokyo; becomes leader of ROLLING GUY on C1 in SB01/SBX. Older brother of Tetsu Kobayakawa.
Rumor: [BBS #355] I am leaving Rokko and heading for the Shuto Expressway.

Bio: A chronic lack of direction led him to take up racing on mountain passes where branching intersections are scarce. Even so, he persistently loses his way and fails to reach agreed rendezvous points, causing many a race to conclude before it even starts. His current life goal is saving enough money to install a GPS car navigation unit.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Mystery Maze); challenges Mount Zao in KB2 (#251).

Bio: The mid-engine V6 Clio, housed in an ultra-lightweight chassis, possesses more than enough performance to match his exceptional skill. Imaizumi, who was always far deadlier through corners than on straights, elevated his driving to terrifying new heights upon acquiring this machine. The undisputed fastest driver on Mount Zao has arrived.
Relationships: Elusive Slasher roaming the snowy peaks of Mount Zao in a mid-engine Clio V6.

Bio: Back when single, his motto was fearless, fiercely aggressive racing; however, ever since having a child, his beloved daughter's face flashes across his mind at every corner entry, instinctively forcing his foot onto the brake pedal. He sneaks out to race behind his wife's back under the guise of "working overtime."
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 White Leopard); challenges passes in KB1 (#189) and KB2 (#293).

Bio: Runs a tuning shop built on the philosophy of balancing date-night comfort with uncompromising top-tier performance; whenever challenged, he travels across Japan from Kyushu and Okinawa to Hokkaido to systematically dismantle his rivals. His R34 features bespoke touge suspension geometry calibrated to track the asphalt like a glove.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Shuto Bancho); challenges Mount Aso in KB2 (#296).

Bio: Ever since mastering foundational car control in gymkhana competitions, he became obsessed with drifting and took to roaming the passes as a self-styled "drift master." Having recently swapped from FR to 4WD, he is struggling mightily to initiate slides, threatening to keep him merely "self-styled" forever.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Grief of Asphalt); challenges passes in KB1 (#185) and KB2 (#303).

Bio: The undisputed fastest driver on Mount Aso. Faced an unannounced challenge from the man calling himself "Hamagaki" and claimed a decisive victory. During that legendary clash, he set a course record so staggering it is widely believed it will never be eclipsed. He disdains factional alliances, operating strictly alone as a quiet, stoic figure.
Relationships: Leader of Forever Knights. Dethroned Hamagaki at Mount Aso in early 2004 to claim the throne of Emotional King.

Bio: Ever since suffering defeat on Irohazaka at the hands of a mysterious lone racer, he transformed into an obsessive demon of revenge. Appearing at famed driving passes across Japan, he continuously duels regional pass kings while relentlessly hunting for the whereabouts of the man who bested him, living daily under the crushing shadow of that single loss.
Relationships: Former Emotional King; suffered a humiliating dethronement at Mount Aso at the hands of Hiroki Kogami (Forever Knights). Exiled into bitter isolation plotting nationwide revanchist vengeance.

Display Name: ティンバースラッシュ
Bio: A remarkably skilled female driver. Frequently seen lurking on the passes observing passing machines, though she rarely initiates battles herself. Rather than cute, she is striking and beautiful, commanding a devoted following of male admirers whom she thoroughly ignores. "I’ve clashed with countless rivals, yet every race felt unfulfilling. But racing you made the fog before my eyes finally lift."
Relationships: Narrative chronicler on the Kaido BBS boards tracking faction shifts and Hamagaki's fall from grace.

Bio: Editorial staff member of a monthly car tuning magazine. Coming from port warehouse straightaways, he originally struggled with dramatic mountain elevation changes. Four years ago he enrolled in driving school to hone his technique, blossoming into a renowned regional team leader. His signature battle cry: "Don't you dare underestimate compact machines!!"
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Bokuchin@Shiotani); challenges Mount Aso in KB2 (#331).

Bio: Devoted to the RX-7, he even named his daughter "Nana." Revering himself as the fastest on Tangerine Mountain, his driving is pure art. Gaining widespread renown on an expedition to Mount Rokko, he welcomed endless challengers. With locals no longer daring to face him, he eagerly awaits out-of-town challengers with immense satisfaction.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB01 Mr. No Fear / Mr. Orange Road); challenges passes in KB1 (#177) and KB2 (#339).

Bio: 2001 D1 Grand Prix Series Champion and 2002 runner-up; an elite cornerstone supporting competitive drifting with ruthless consistency. Carrying the immense prestige of HKS Works on his shoulders brings immense pressure. An all-around professional racing driver actively competing in Japan's Super GT championship.
Relationships: Real-world D1 Grand Prix champion and professional driver; featured as elite guest star in KB1 (#102) and KB2 (#350).

Notes: All Passes / Gymkhana | Pinnacle Touge Master & 20 Masters Arbiter
Bio: The solitary master reigning at the apex of the gymkhana world and All-Japan touge trials. The symbolic pillar uniting the elite 20 drivers of "TWENTY MASTER." Tames the most treacherous passes through transcendent car control and millimeter-precise steering input. Though commanding total mastery over all drivetrains, he honed his mid-engine NSX-R to the absolute bleeding edge. Defeating him is the ultimate status symbol for any mountain racer.
Relationships: Supreme arbiter of the Gymkhana & 20 Masters tournament across all mountain passes in Kaido Battle 2 and Kaido Battle 3. Revered by regional touge kings and touring expressway veterans as the living standard of precision vehicle control; stands alongside Master Lord Haruhiko Kasai as the ultimate test of racing discipline.
Rumor: [NEW] ...Words are unnecessary. Let your driving speak. / [CONQUEST] ...Exquisite. There is not a single trace of hesitation in your driving.

Notes: All Passes / Gymkhana | Supreme Sovereign of Gymkhana Tournament
Bio: The sovereign apex above all masters ruling Japan's mountain passes and gymkhana arenas—the Master Lord. A charismatic living legend who swept official motorsport championships before ascending to the pinnacle of the underground touge scene. Piloting an overwhelmingly powerful, fully tuned GT-R with the featherlight grace of a bird, he carves through catastrophic weather, blizzards, and hairpin bends at otherworldly cornering speeds, plunging all challengers into awe and despair.
Relationships: Supreme grandmaster, tournament sovereign, and final pinnacle boss of the Gymkhana & 20 Masters system in Kaido Battle 2 and Kaido Battle 3. Rules above all regional leaders, Emotional Kings, and syndicate vanguards in raw driving mastery; serves as the absolute zenith of the Genki mountain pass universe.
Rumor: [NEW] ...So you have managed to reach this summit. However, here lies the impenetrable wall of limits. / [CONQUEST] ...Magnificent. I entrust the pinnacle of this pass to you.
